This facilitated large-scale supply chain attacks, including user redirection to phishing or malware sites, credential theft via DOM access, and propagation of further malicious payloads through compromised client browsers.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Scan all HTML, JavaScript, and template files for script inclusions referencing cdn.polyfill.io or related suspicious domains. Monitor runtime network activity in browsers for requests to these domains or for redirection events initiated by polyfill scripts. Alert on any polyfill scripts performing actions beyond feature shimming, such as unauthorized DOM manipulation, user redirection, or network exfiltration. Correlate script inclusion with domain registration and ownership changes to identify supply chain risks.
